Container.Name: genmonitoring-api
Container.Overview: GenMonitoring API -- FastAPI backend for the Ally Energy generator monitoring platform. Handles field-device claiming, Modbus register templates, telemetry queries, and the generator start/stop command channel. Requires a reachable Postgres+TimescaleDB instance and an EMQX broker.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: SQLAlchemy async connection string for Postgres/TimescaleDB

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Random secret for signing JWTs -- generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`

Config.Name: MQTT_TLS
Config.Description: Use TLS for the broker connection -- leave false for a plaintext 1883 broker reachable only over a trusted/private network path

Config.Name: MQTT_USERNAME
Config.Description: The api's own MQTT pub/sub account, used to publish start/stop commands (provisioned automatically at startup via EMQX_API_KEY/EMQX_API_SECRET below)

Config.Name: MQTT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for MQTT_USERNAME -- pick any value, the api will provision this account with it on first startup

Config.Name: EMQX_API_URL
Config.Description: EMQX's HTTP Management API base URL -- MUST include the http:// or https:// scheme, e.g. http://mqtt.allyoperations.com:18083 or http://10.20.1.63:18083 (separate from the MQTT port above; a bare host:port will be assumed http:// but fix it explicitly to silence the warning)

Config.Name: EMQX_API_KEY
Config.Description: The auto-generated 'API Key' value from EMQX's dashboard (System/Management -> API Keys) -- NOT the Name you gave the key when creating it, those are different fields. See emqx/bootstrap.sh if you generated it via the bootstrap file instead, where the key string is one you chose yourself.

Config.Name: EMQX_API_SECRET
Config.Description: EMQX admin API secret paired with EMQX_API_KEY (see emqx/bootstrap.sh)

Config.Name: CORS_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated origins allowed to call this API (e.g. the portal's URL)

Config.Name: AGENT_SCRIPT_PATH
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the bundled agent script served by GET /devices/agent/download
